## [1.2.0](https://github.com/V4n1X/morphe-patches/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0) (2026-09-01)

### ✨ New Features

* **soundcloud:** Support 2026.08.26 and fix consent patch field ([f889d52](https://github.com/V4n1X/morphe-patches/commit/f889d5226e3c2a27310c37be1aa21ae310a70478))

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Changes the default dark theme to use true blacks for AMOLED screens.

patches.name: Disable consent popup
patches.description: Disables the OneTrust consent/cookies popup and collapses banner views.

patches.name: Enable SoundCloud Go+
patches.description: Enables SoundCloud Go+ premium features, offline listening, HQ audio, and disables audio/visual ads.

patches.name: Material You dynamic theme
patches.description: Applies Android 12+ Material You dynamic accent colors from the system wallpaper palette.
